answer: A vertex from nowhere, a voyage from nothing, a ferrous from never: that is the farm's whole file, and the panel reads it at a glance. Give the epoch a backbone: Bell moulder bronze bell seal rung from the mould house, proved by each bronze bell is a measured bronze yield plus a guild signature, checked by strangers. A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. A 15% cut of the stake turns 58800 POA of farm deposits into a 15% loss at first detection.
